description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-09-11)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ci:** align workflows with upstream morphe-patches ([4c33cc6](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/4c33cc696ddd0ff8e67e3c512eb7c87c57906876))
* **ci:** job-level permissions and Dependabot registry auth ([180b51c](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/180b51c1e837d49442fed17507eebf6072443c9f))
* **pairip:** force restore/devirt as dependencies of PairIP removal ([9270531](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/9270531321785e6e24c2d61b8e96e906e6d795b1))
* **premium:** resolve PremiumStatusParser directly by definingClass ([062543d](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/062543d5cdaf1749aac762e04f8198a154b7e916))

### ✨ New Features

* **devirt:** de-virtualize the override methods PairIP relocated ([ade1130](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/ade11301ecbd7001ae93226bc29fa710777cf42d))
* initial patches for あすけん (jp.co.greenhouse.asken) ([2832c4c](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/2832c4c853c59a325a4f95651c076482b1a03a3c))
* **pairip:** fully disable PairIP so no native code runs ([d736325](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/d736325d987545c4dfd1f6313cba2d728ed14bda))
* **pairip:** sever Play-license paywall paths as defense-in-depth ([688d925](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/688d9257049ae5d70738e30221daf31c39b86714))
* **premium:** add full unlock of the nutrient ranking ([2df52ff](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/2df52ff6047c701fd8444ffb918e576faae87a2c))
* **restore:** statically restore the obfuscated static Strings PairIP decrypts ([4fa5227](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/4fa522742d84f2478b493a2d7762ea516180e4f9))
* **ylpacker:** reimplement YLPacker in Java so libylpacker never loads ([f4458df](https://github.com/Nerahikada/asken-patches/commit/f4458df2eab8e2dc9e4d1490c9d090fa5068e90e))

apps.app_name: あすけんダイエットアプリ カロリー計算や食事記録でダイエット

patches.name: De-virtualize PairIP methods
patches.description: PairIP relocated 20 framework-override method bodies into runtime-generated classes reached via reflected Methods that are null once PairIP is removed. Restores safe behavior: ContentProvider.onCreate returns true, other ContentProvider/onBind return null/0, Activity lifecycle overrides delegate to super. Third-party login/deeplink/health flows degrade gracefully; core features are unaffected.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables all in-app advertising by preventing ad SDK initialization and suppressing ad containers.

patches.name: Disable PairIP
patches.description: Fully removes PairIP so no native code runs: skips the startup VM program (StartupLauncher.launch), prevents libpairipcore from loading (VMRunner.<clinit> return-void, where System.loadLibrary lives), and no-ops the signature/license gates. libpairipcore staying out is what keeps the Play-license paywall away; the only thing that needed its VM — YLPacker — is reimplemented in Java (see reimplementYlpackerPatch). Decrypted Strings and virtualized bodies are rebuilt by the Restore and De-virtualize patches.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Blocks analytics and tracking SDKs (Repro, Firebase Analytics, Facebook) to prevent user profiling.

patches.name: Reimplement YLPacker in Java
patches.description: Replaces com.yl.pack.YLPacker's native packJNI/unpackJNI (HEX+AES-128-ECB, key "yolandakitnewhdr") with a pure-Java equivalent and skips loadLibrary("ylpacker"), so libylpacker.so — which is DT_NEEDED on libpairipcore.so and would drag PairIP + its Play-license paywall back in — never loads. Lets PairIP stay fully removed.

patches.name: Restore encrypted strings
patches.description: Repopulates the obfuscated static String holders that PairIP's startup VM decrypts at runtime (1466 values dumped from the original-signed app via am dumpheap), so removing PairIP no longer leaves them null.

patches.name: Unlock nutrient ranking
patches.description: Unlocks the full food nutrient ranking (食べたもの栄養素ランキング). The server already sends every ranked item with its real values to free accounts; the app merely masks the numbers based on the client-trusted enable_full_nut_ranking flag. Forcing that flag to 1 reveals the already-downloaded values and enables switching the ranked nutrient.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features by forcing the local premium status to Premium.
